name: AgentCore in a Box
description: Grab-and-go Amazon Bedrock AgentCore demo. One command deploys four verticalized 11-agent desks (Capital Markets, Insurance, Banking, FinTech) on one shared platform, wiring 12 of the 13 AgentCore primitives live (Gateway, Policy, Identity, Browser, Code Interpreter, Memory, Runtime, Evaluations, Registry, Harness, Optimization, Observability). Includes a live admin RBAC governance layer enforced at four independent layers (Runtime pre-check, Gateway interceptor, Cedar policy, IAM Deny backstop).

frameworks.name: Strands Agents SDK
frameworks.description: 11-specialist multi-agent desk (Swarm + Graph topologies) per vertical, one shared arm64 container

deployment_patterns.name: AWS CDK
deployment_patterns.description: CDK (TypeScript) + AgentCore control-plane CLI orchestrated by deploy.sh; ARM64 agent container pushed to ECR

parameters.name: project_name
parameters.description: Project name prefix for all AWS resources

parameters.name: aws_region
parameters.description: AWS region to deploy into (must be an AgentCore-available region)

example_use_cases: Capital Markets fixed-income desk (Meridian Asset Management) with Investment Committee verdict
Insurance P&C + Life underwriting desk (Ridgeline Mutual) with Underwriting Committee bind
Banking commercial-credit desk (Rampart Financial) with Credit Committee approve/decline
FinTech payments/risk desk (Kairo) with Risk & Growth Council ship/hold
Live admin RBAC + Cedar policy governance demo with four-layer defense-in-depth enforcement
author: AVA Team
